Convotherm maxx pro easyTouch 10.20 ES spec sheet (Welbilt, 07/23)

easytouch1020.summary: The Convotherm Maxx Pro easyTouch 10.20 is a ten-plus-one shelf (GN 2/1) combi oven with a 10 inch touchscreen, Press&Go programs and automatic cleaning. It needs a three-phase 400V supply at about 33.7 kW. Suits high-volume restaurant, hotel and contract catering kitchens.

highlights.text: easyTouch 10 inch TFT HiRes capacitive glass touch display
Cooking modes: steam 30-130 °C, combi-steam 30-250 °C, convection 30-250 °C (Natural Smart Climate ACS+)
TriColor indicator ring shows current operating status
Integrated recoil hand shower and multi-point core temperature probe

facts.label: Maximum loading per shelf level (GN 1/1 / 600 x 400)

facts.value: 2 x G 3/4'' fixed connection, optionally including connecting pipe (min. DN13 / 1/2'')

facts.label: Drain
facts.value: DN 50 (min. internal diameter 46 mm); funnel drain with P-trap recommended, or fixed connection

facts.label: Water quality, supply for cleaning / hand shower (connection B)
facts.value: Drinking water, typically hard water; general hardness 4 - 20 °dH / 70 - 360 ppm; pH 6.5 - 8.5; chloride max. 60 mg/l; free chlorine max. 0.2 mg/l; sulphate max. 150 mg/l; iron max. 0.1 mg/l; silicate max. 13 mg/l; monochloramine max. 0.2 mg/l; max. 40 °C; conductivity min. 20 µS/cm

easytouch1020.notes: Caterkwik 'weight 38 kg' is the packaging weight (empty 190-195 kg). Caterkwik 'gnCapacity 1/1GN' conflicts with the sheet (10+1 shelves GN 2/1). Caterkwik W1121 x D991 x H762 equals the 6.20 and looks copied; not recorded. Page MPN is the family code; sheets are EB and ES. Gas sheets exist, not recorded.

sources.title: Electrolux Professional 900XP two wells electric fryer 23 liter spec sheet (391385 / 391338)

electrolux391090twintankelectricfryer.summary: The Electrolux Professional 900XP twin-well electric fryer (391338) has two 23 litre V-shaped wells heated by external infrared elements, 36 kW in total on a three-phase supply. It is supplied with four half-size baskets and cupboard doors. Suits busy restaurants and canteens frying large volumes.

highlights.text: External infrared elements with deflectors for easier well cleaning
IPX5 water resistance; control knobs sealed against water
Oil drains via tap into a container under the wells

facts.label: Wells
facts.value: 2 'V' shaped wells with external heating elements

facts.label: Heating elements
facts.value: High efficiency external infrared elements (36 kW) with deflectors on the outside of the well

facts.label: Feet
facts.value: Four 50 mm stainless steel legs as standard (height adjustable)

facts.label: Worktop / panels
facts.value: Worktop in 20/10 stainless steel; exterior panels stainless steel with Scotch Brite finish

facts.label: Oil drain
facts.value: Tap into container under the wells

facts.label: Clearance to sensitive surfaces
facts.value: Safety gap of approx. 150 mm or heat insulation

facts.label: Baskets supplied
facts.value: 4 half size baskets (2 x pack of 2 half size baskets for 18/23 lt fryers, PNC 927223)

facts.label: Doors supplied
facts.value: 2 x door for open base cupboard (PNC 206350)

images.alt: Electrolux Professional 900XP twin tank electric fryer 391338

electrolux391090twintankelectricfryer.notes: Sheet covers 391385 and 391338; only 391338 values used. External width/height not on the sheet, so Caterkwik 800 x 930 x 908 is unverified. Sheet gives no amps (Caterkwik 90 A), filtration or cold zone; Caterkwik says 3 baskets but the sheet says 4 half-size baskets. Warranty not stated.

Electrolux Professional 700XP Two Wells Freestanding Gas Fryer 15 liter (COD 371071)

electrolux371072singletankgastubefryer.summary: The Electrolux Professional 700XP freestanding gas fryer (371071) has two 15 litre V-shaped wells with four 7 kW burners, 28 kW gas in total, supplied for natural gas with LPG conversion jets. It comes with two full-size baskets and cupboard doors. Suits restaurants and takeaways frying in volume.

highlights.text: Four 7 kW stainless steel burners, flame failure device on each
Piezo spark ignition; natural gas or LPG with conversion jets supplied
Oil drains through a tap into a container under the well

electrolux371072singletankgastubefryer.notes: Sheet gives no external W/D/H (Caterkwik 800 x 730 x 850 unverified; a search summary quoted the same). Caterkwik 'voltage 700 v' is the 700XP series name; 'electricKw 7 kW' is per burner; chip output 38 kg/hr and filtration are not on the sheet. Sheet working pressure '0/0 mbar' looks like a data gap. Warranty not stated.
